minimum_wages.source: Chief Commissioner ICT, Directorate of Industries and Labour Welfare, Notification No. ADLW 8(20)-ICT/2024-934 of 19 August 2026 under section 4 of the Minimum Wages Ordinance 1961: adult unskilled workers Rs. 40,700 a month from 1 July 2026. Copy read at https://efp.org.pk/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/ICT-Minimum-Wage-2026-27.pdf

Government of Sindh, Labour and Human Resources Department, Notification No. SO(L-II)/13-3/2016-II of 17 August 2026 under section 6(1)(a) of the Sindh Minimum Wages Act 2015: unskilled adult, juvenile and adolescent workers Rs. 43,000 a month from 1 July 2026. Copy read at https://efp.org.pk/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/SindhWageNotification2026.pdf
